items.pass_rule: verified inbox AND business domain (not free/disposable) AND domain matches submitted company domain
active/current company AND exact normalized match on name + address + registration number
exact handle exists AND org name matches company AND address materially matches AND no broker/rejected-entity conflict
POC associated with submitted ORG-ID/resource AND token sent to RIR-listed email is verified
OCR-extracted name/address/number/jurisdiction match submission AND no conflict with official registry evidence
person name AND current company AND title AND company domain all match deterministically
reviewer confirms: domain resolves, HTTPS, genuine company content tied to applicant, not parked, no fraud indicators
items.notes: No automated website adapter in v1. Points awarded only on reviewer pass.

dynamic_rules: Every evidence update creates a new check that supersedes the prior check of that type; checks are immutable.
Score is computed only from live (non-superseded) checks.
ORG-ID contributes at most 25; POC at most 25.
If ORG-ID changes, the old ORG-ID check is superseded (points removed) and any verified POC is revalidated against the new ORG-ID; if not associated, the POC check is superseded too.
If the POC handle changes, outstanding tokens expire, the old POC check is superseded, and a new token is sent to the new RIR-listed email.
manual_review_insufficient auto-clears on any recalculation that meets the threshold with all hard gates passing.
